how_to_query:
CRISIL does NOT use Workday/Taleo/SuccessFactors. Its careers portal at https://career.crisil.com/crisil/ is an Angular SPA backed by the Indian ATS **Zwayam**. I recovered the tenant config from the JS bundle (https://career.crisil.com/crisil/main.211cf4b3c45f9585.js), which contains: COMPANYID:"MTU0Mzg=" (base64 -> 15438), DOMAIN:"career.crisil.com", APIENDPOINT:"https://public.zwayam.com/". Search is POST with FormData (GET returns HTTP 405); objects must be JSON.stringify'd into form fields. Page size is HARD-CAPPED SERVER-SIDE AT 10 (passing paginationHowMuch is ignored) so you must paginate 68 times for the full 678-job set.

STEP 1 - LIST (all 678 jobs, 10 per page, increment paginationStartNo by 10):
curl -s --compressed -A "Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/120.0" \
  -H "Origin: https://career.crisil.com" -H "Referer: https://career.crisil.com/" \
  -X POST "https://public.zwayam.com/jobs/search" \
  -F 'filterCri={"paginationStartNo":0,"selectedCall":"sort","sortCriteria":{"name":"modifiedDate","isAscending":false},"anyOfTheseWords":""}' \
  -F 'domain=career.crisil.com' \
  -F 'companyId=MTU0Mzg='
-> {"data":{"totalCount":678,"data":[{"_source":{...}}],"facets":{"Location":[...],"Job Category":[...]}}}
Each _source carries jobTitle, jobCode, jobUrl, jobLocationRecord[{city,state,country}], minYearOfExperience, maxYearOfExperience, experienceUIField, departmentName, eduqualification, skillSet, createDate. Add "anyOfTheseWords":"<keyword>" to search.

STEP 2 - FULL JD (note: JSON body here, NOT FormData; companyId is the DECODED "15438"):
curl -s --compressed -A "Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/120.0" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: https://career.crisil.com" -H "Referer: https://career.crisil.com/" \
  -X POST "https://public.zwayam.com/jobs-service/v1/jobs/careersite" \
  -d '{"jobUrl":"intern-mumbai-maharashtra-india-2026091011292585","externalSource":"CAREERSITE","campusUrl":"empty","companyId":"15438"}'
-> returns longDescription (full HTML JD), skillSet, desiredSkill, locationSeparatedbySlash, noOfApplications.

STEP 3 - HUMAN-READABLE URL (this is what you actually apply on):
https://career.crisil.com/crisil/jobview/<jobUrl>
e.g. https://career.crisil.com/crisil/jobview/intern-mumbai-maharashtra-india-2026091011292585

Also confirmed working: the S&P Global parent Workday tenant, which is SEPARATE from CRISIL and carries only 35 India jobs (none CRISIL-branded, mostly Hyderabad/Gurugram/Noida SDE+security):
curl -s -X POST "https://spgi.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/spgi/SPGI_Careers/jobs" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"appliedFacets":{},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":"India"}'
student_programs:
FOUND AND OPEN — this is CRISIL's single biggest advantage over Amazon for Omkar. CRISIL does NOT run a named, cohort-based, deadline-gated graduate programme (no "CRISIL Analyst Programme 2027" exists on the portal). Instead it posts **rolling, individually-requisitioned intern / apprentice / trainee reqs directly on the public careers site, year-round, with no graduation-year gate and no campus-portal wall**. All of the following are LIVE and OPEN right now (status=1 in the feed, lastAppliedOnDate=null on every single req — i.e. NO application deadline is set on any CRISIL job):

TIER 1 — OPEN, MUMBAI, EXPLICITLY ACCEPTS B.TECH STUDENTS, PERFECT FOR A JAN–MAY 2027 FINAL-SEM INTERNSHIP:
1. [21209] "Intern", MI&A / FS Consulting, Mumbai, posted 08-Sep-2026 (FRESHEST INTERN REQ ON THE SITE, 16 days old). Verbatim: "Qualifications & Requirements: Students pursuing MBA/Btech/BBA/Bcom/CA /CFA". **Btech is named explicitly.** Skills asked: Excel, PowerPoint, Data Analysis, Research. Education field literally says "pursuing UG/PG" — it is built for a student who has not graduated. This is the single best-fit posting in the entire 678-job feed.
2. [20511] "Internship Trainee - AI Engg.", Data and AI, Mumbai + Pune, posted 23-Jun-2026. Verbatim: "Candidate looking for 4 - 6 months of internship in the field of AI. Preferrably candidates from mathematics and enggineering backgroung." Education field: "Undergraduates in Engineering or Mathematics field". **A 4–6 month window starting January 2027 lands exactly on May 2027.** This req is written for precisely his situation.
3. [20943] "Apprentice - Metadata Management & Data Cataloging", Data and AI, Mumbai, posted 14-Aug-2026. Apprentice-grade, "Upto 1 years", Python + SQL + data governance on the OpenMetadata platform.
4. [18806] "Intern - SQL Developer", MI&A, Mumbai, posted 30-Jan-2026. Education: "B.Tech / CDAC / MCA". Verbatim: "Need to hire a intern with basic SQL knowledge... Good to have skills would be python development including Flask / Django". Lowest bar of any technical req in the feed.
5. [21014] "Intern", MI&A / FS Consulting, Mumbai, posted 25-Aug-2026 — same team as 21209 but qualification line omits Btech ("Students pursuing BBA/Bcom/CA /CFA"). Apply to 21209 first; this is the backup.
6. [18254] "Intern – Financial services research", MI&A, Mumbai, posted 12-Dec-2025 — fintech/NBFC research profiling; wants "MBA / CA / CFA Level 1–2, or those with fintech, digital lending, or analytics certifications preferred". The "analytics certifications" clause is his way in without an MBA.
7. [20966] "Intern - Internal Business Controls", GIX-GBA, Mumbai, posted 18-Aug-2026 — explicitly wants "Working knowledge of using AI and process automation tools", which his LLM/agent work covers. Education listed as Bcom/Mcom so it is a stretch on paper.
8. [18874] "Intern", MI&A, Mumbai, posted 05-Feb-2026 — primary-research/survey fieldwork, "GRaduate". Lowest-value of the Mumbai interns; telephonic survey work.

TIER 2 — OPEN, PUNE (requires relocation, but near-perfect skill overlap):
9. [18501] "Generative AI Intern", Data and AI, Pune, posted 06-Jan-2026. Education: "B.Tech". Verbatim requirements: Python, LLMs "such as GPT-style models", "Prompt engineering", "Transformers (basic understanding)", "OpenAI APIs / Hugging Face (preferred)", "NumPy, Pandas (basic level)". **His KOP AI project (10 parallel stateful LLM agents, RAG, Groq/Llama 3.1) overshoots every line of this JD.** If he will consider Pune, this is his highest-probability offer in the whole company.
10. [19687] "Apprentice/Retainer-1 Year Contract", GAC, Pune, posted 27-Mar-2026 — "Upto 2 years"; Excel + SQL + Power BI, "Knowledge of Python and SQL would be preferred"; education explicitly includes "Data Science".

TIER 3 — TRAINEE-TITLED BUT ACTUALLY EXPERIENCED HIRES (trap — do not waste an application):
- [17895] "Graduate Trainee", MI&A, Mumbai — title says trainee but JD is senior fixed-income index construction and it wants CFA/FRM.
- [20818] "Management Trainee", Ratings, Mumbai — JD is rating-criteria formulation defended before a credit committee; education "MBA".
- [20739] "Management Trainee - Credit Analyst", GR&RS, Pune — JD body contradicts the title: "Atleast 3 years of experience in Asset Management"; wants Macabacus. Skip.
- [14704] "Credit Analyst ( Intern )", MI&A, Mumbai — education field is hard "CA". Skip.

CAMPUS PIPELINE: the portal's Angular router does expose a dedicated campus route (`jobview/campus/:jobUrl`) and the search API has an `isCampusEnabledForJob` field — but that field is null on all 678 live jobs, so CRISIL's campus drives are NOT run through the public site. They run through college placement cells. DJSCE is a top-tier Mumbai engineering college and CRISIL's HQ is in Mumbai (Powai/Chandivali), so the correct parallel move is for Omkar to ask the DJSCE T&P cell directly whether CRISIL is on the 2026-27 recruiting calendar — that channel is invisible to this feed.

REFERRAL LEVERAGE: HIGH, and unusually actionable here. `noOfApplications` is exposed on every job and reads **0** across the board, and 63 of 678 reqs have `ijpEnabled:true` (internal job posting). The Zwayam portal is low-traffic and recruiter-driven rather than algorithmically screened. Better still, the search API exposes `primaryRecruiterName` and `primaryRecruiterEmailId` per job, and the job record names the hiring team (`departmentName`: MI&A, GAC, GR&RS, Data and AI, GIX-GBA). CRISIL is Mumbai-headquartered with a very large DJSCE/Mumbai-engineering alumni base, so a LinkedIn referral into MI&A, Data and AI or GIX-GBA is realistic and will matter more than the portal itself.
limitations:
WHAT I GOT: complete. I pulled all 678 live CRISIL reqs (100% of the public feed, 68 paginated calls), then fetched 44 full verbatim JDs via the detail endpoint. Every qualification block below is copied verbatim from `longDescription`; nothing is paraphrased or invented.

WHAT I COULD NOT GET:
1. NO APPLICATION DEADLINES EXIST. `lastAppliedOnDate` is null on all 678 reqs, so I can state a job is live (status=1) but I cannot tell you when any of them closes. "OPEN" below means "present and active in the feed on 24-Sep-2026", not "confirmed accepting applications until date X".
2. NO APPLICATION-VOLUME SIGNAL. `noOfApplications` returns 0 on every job including reqs posted in 2024. The field is clearly not populated on the public API, so I cannot tell you which postings are crowded. Do not read 0 as "nobody has applied".
3. STALE REQS ARE MIXED IN WITH FRESH ONES AND THE FEED DOES NOT DISTINGUISH THEM. The feed contains jobs posted as far back as Dec-2024 ([14704], [10169]) still flagged status=1. CRISIL evidently does not expire postings. I have given `posted` for every role — treat anything older than ~6 months as probably dead regardless of its status flag. This is the single biggest caveat in this report.
4. I DID NOT PULL FULL JDs FOR ALL 573 INDIA ROLES — only the 44 most relevant. There are ~160 more India reqs at <=4 years experience I triaged by title/skill metadata only. If you want the long tail, the pagination recipe above retrieves it.
5. SOME REQS ARE INTERNAL JUNK, NOT REAL POSTINGS. [20725] "Senior Analyst" Mumbai has a `longDescription` reading in full: "Raising Replacement of Shurti Jadhav who left Crisil in Jan 26. As her replacement we hired Anirudh Mehta from bench" — i.e. already filled. [20633] "Intern" Mumbai reads "Tester - Please approve". [19981] is titled "requisition-against-arun-janhavi-manjrekar-03as0542". I excluded these from the role list; be aware the feed is not clean and other reqs may be similarly dead.
6. TITLE AND EXPERIENCE METADATA FREQUENTLY CONTRADICT THE JD BODY. Examples: [19033] "Power Bi Developer" is tagged 2-4 years in metadata but the JD demands "5+ years of experience in Power BI development" and "Relevant Certifications are a must". [20755] is tagged 3-8y but the JD says "2–5 years". [20925] tagged 3-8y, JD says "4-7 years". [20948] has a nonsensical range (2-0 years). I have used the JD body text for `years_required` wherever the two disagree, and flagged it.
7. NO CAMPUS FEED. The `jobview/campus/` route exists but no live job has campus enabled, so CRISIL's DJSCE-facing campus process is not visible via any API. That must be chased through the college placement cell.
8. NO SALARY DATA. `salary`, `minJobSalary`, `maxJobSalary` are empty/null across the board.
9. S&P GLOBAL PARENT WORKDAY IS A SEPARATE, LARGELY IRRELEVANT PIPELINE. It returns 35 India jobs, none CRISIL-branded, concentrated in Hyderabad/Gurugram/Noida and skewed to senior SDE, cloud security and data-platform roles (Director/Distinguished Engineer grade). Only one Mumbai role appears there ([329265] Senior IT Audit Manager, Cybersecurity & Technology) and it is far too senior. I did not include these in the role list because they are not CRISIL openings.
10. HONEST FIT WARNING ON THE MUMBAI ANALYST BAND. Nearly every non-intern Mumbai analytics req in MI&A/Ratings/GR&RS asks for MBA (Finance) / CA / CA-Inter / CFA L1-L2 as the education line, not B.Tech. Omkar's B.Tech CSE (Data Science) does not satisfy those on paper, and this is NOT a gap he can close with a 2-6 week certification. The realistic CRISIL route for him is the intern/apprentice tier (where the education line reads "pursuing UG/PG", "B.Tech / CDAC / MCA", or "Undergraduates in Engineering") plus the Data and AI and GAC technical reqs — not the credit/ratings analyst ladder. I have ordered the roles accordingly and stated the education line verbatim on each so the mismatch is visible rather than papered over.

roles.title: Research Associate (Corporate Thematic Research)
roles.basic_qualifications:
Functional Responsibility / Domain Related
 - Supporting S&P Analysts in thematic publications for the Corporate domain and other ad-hoc reports
 - Proficiency in Databricks for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows.
 - Strong experience in building dashboards and visualizations within Databricks (e.g., Databricks SQL dashboards) to support business and analytical insights
 - Ability to design and automate end-to-end data processes in Databricks, including scheduling, monitoring, and optimization.
 - Advanced SQL skills, with experience writing complex queries, performance tuning, and working with large, structured and semi-structured datasets
 - Expert-level Python proficiency, including data manipulation, reusable scripting, and development of production-grade analytical code.
 - Strong understanding of data engineering and analytics best practices, with the ability to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
 - Actively participate in the team/client calls and review meetings, alert the S&P analyst and the Manager about any exceptions or any emerging difficulties in the smooth execution of work within timelines
 - Conversant with excel spreadsheets and report writing
 - Execute analytical reports related to macro-economics, bonds markets and corporate rating actions
 - Update task level operating manuals to document new knowledge gained and new processes
 - Actively participate in forums across GAC
roles.preferred_qualifications: Process Adherence: Adopt and adhere to the defined processes in day to day execution of assignments as well as organization wide requirements. Strictly practice and follow all Information Security Policies, Procedures and Guidelines of the Organization. Client Management / Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain cordial and healthy work relationships with onshore clients. Education field: 'MBA Finance'. Skills listed on req: Databricks, python, SQL. Department: GAC.
roles.description_gist: Mumbai, GAC, 1-3 years, and only three named skills: Databricks, Python, SQL. He owns two of the three outright, and the JD's phrasing 'Expert-level Python proficiency, including data manipulation, reusable scripting, and development of production-grade analytical code' describes work he has actually shipped (FastAPI services, ThreadPoolExecutor orchestration, ONNX inference pipelines). GAPS: (a) Databricks appears FOUR times and is the spine of the role - this is a genuine hard gap; (b) education field says MBA Finance, which conflicts with a req whose entire skill list is engineering; (c) 'Advanced SQL... complex queries, performance tuning' is a notch above his current level. EDGE IN 2-6 WEEKS: this is one of the best learnable-gap-to-job ratios in the list. Databricks Community Edition is free; the Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate is ~3-4 weeks of part-time study and is notebook-based PySpark plus SQL, NOT a heavy language like Java or Scala. Pair it with 2 weeks of advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query plans, indexing). That combination takes him from unqualified to genuinely credible on this exact posting, and also strengthens roles 13, 15 and 20.
